headline: Argentina Central Bank Rules Out Extra Liquidity Injection to Boost Consumption
summary: Central Bank President Santiago Bausili stated the entity will not inject additional liquidity into the system to incentivize consumption, emphasizing efforts to build credibility.
why: Central bank monetary restraint and credibility-building measures affect domestic interest rates, inflation expectations, and currency stability.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Refusing to inject liquidity impacts domestic money supply and monetary policy stance.
